    for start_station in range(1, n + 1):

            distance_to_candy = min(abs(a_i - current_station), n - abs(a_i - current_station))
            
            # Move to the candy's station
            total_time += distance_to_candy

            # Move to the destination station
            total_time += distance_to_destination
            
            # Update the current station to the destination station
            current_station = b_i
            
            # Update the last visited time for the destination station
            last_visited[b_i] = total_time
        
        # Add the maximum time taken to visit all stations to the result
        result.append(max(last_visited))
    
    return result
